content.text:
I submitted **index 25 (Sb fraction 0.84)** as the best composition. It had the highest EQE of the five I measured: **0.0180%**.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | 0.39 | 0.0101 |
| 18 | 0.67 (the CoSb2O6 ratio) | 0.0015 |
| 22 | 0.78 | 0.0093 |
| **25** | **0.84** | **0.0180** |
| 28 | 0.865 | 0.0163 |

- **Where the best region is:** EQE is highest at the Sb-rich end. Among my measurements it peaks at index 25 and drops on both sides (0.78 and 0.865). The CoSb2O6 ratio (Sb 0.67), my starting guess, was nearly inactive.
- **Structure:** I spent one of the 5 XRD measurements, on index 25. Its peaks look like a rutile-type structure, which fits a Sb-rich rutile oxide containing some Co.
- **Gaps:** Most of the line was never measured, including the Co-rich end below Sb 0.39 and the middle range (0.43–0.64). The Sb-rich peak probably falls between indices 23 and 27, but I couldn't pin it down more closely. A composition somewhere else on the line could beat index 25 without my knowing.
